schema: CREATE TABLE "booths" ("booth_id" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "is_open" INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT a.booth_id FROM booths AS a JOIN booths AS b ON ABS(a.booth_id - b.booth_id) = 1 AND a.is_open = TRUE AND b.is_open = TRUE ORDER BY a.booth_id

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Replaces a.is_open = TRUE AND b.is_open = TRUE with a.is_open + b.is_open = 2, which erroneously admits adjacent rows with (is_open = 2, is_open = 0).
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: SELECT DISTINCT a.booth_id FROM booths AS a CROSS JOIN booths AS b WHERE ABS(a.booth_id - b.booth_id) = 1 AND a.is_open + b.is_open = 2 ORDER BY a.booth_id ASC
